C1035.title: Four 'Insiders' in Xiamen Sentenced for Illegally Stealing Personal Information
C1035.summary: In August 2023, the Siming District Court in Xiamen pronounced a verdict in a case involving the infringement of citizens' personal information. Defendants Ma, Yang, Chen, and Wang used computer technology to infiltrate the backend of a technology company's order tracking system, illegally stealing over 70,000 pieces of personal information and selling it for profit.
